faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes SL65 AMG use?
faqLeft.a: The SL65 AMG uses the M275 — a 6.0-litre twin-turbo V12. It was fitted across both the R230 (2001–2012) and R231 (2012–2021) generations.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes SL65 AMG engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £8,000+. The V12 sits on its own price tier due to significantly higher parts complexity and specialist labour requirements compared to the V8 and six-cylinder engines in the SL range. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my SL65 AMG?
faqLeft.a: All SL65 AMG models use the M275 V12. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact generation and specification.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M275 SL65 AMG engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings, gaskets, and coolant components as standard on every M275 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used SL65 AMG engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my SL65 AMG if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does an SL65 AMG engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most SL65 AMG owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
